title: Error response
description: The body of every 4xx and 5xx response (docs/spec-v1.md, sections 7 and 13).

message.description: For a person. Not stable; act on code.

retryable.description: Whether sending the same request again can succeed.

retry_after_seconds.description: With RATE_LIMITED: the same number as the Retry-After header.

next_cycle.description: With INVALID_RECURRENCE_CYCLE: the cycle to request.

outstanding_until.description: With OFFER_INVOICE_OUTSTANDING: when the open invoice lapses.

cause_code.description: The code of the failure underneath. With OFFER_INVALID: why the stored offer does not verify. With a 502 or 503 from the merchant node: the node's or the network's own error code, a JSON-RPC number included, written as a string.

code.description: One of the codes of spec section 13. Upper-case words joined by underscores.
